name: carelens
description: CareLens: Unified clinical view across EHR, lab, pharmacy, and insurer systems

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n "backend,web" -c "teal,cyan" "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: concurrently -s all --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,web" -c "magenta,blue" "uv run --directory backend pytest" "npm --prefix web run test"
scripts.lint: concurrently -s all --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,web" -c "yellow,green" "uv run --directory backend ruff check ." "npm --prefix web run lint"
